## Summary

Describe the change and the user, integrator, or protocol outcome it enables.

## Verification

- [ ] `./scripts/test-all.sh`
- [ ] `node scripts/verify-provenance-map.mjs`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has appropriate unit, fuzz, invariant, or fork coverage.
- [ ] Any runtime bytecode change and deployment impact are explained.
- [ ] No `deploy/mainnet/*` tag was moved, deleted, or retargeted.
- [ ] No secrets, private RPC URLs, or signing material are included.
